name: Pork, Green Bean & Bell Pepper Stir Fry with Cashews
instructions: Fill a medium saucepan about halfway with water, cover, and bring to a boil.
Wash the green beans and trim ends; transfer to a bowl. Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, add the beans and cook until bright green and tender-crisp, 3-4 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Wash, seed, and slice the bell peppers lengthwise into strips; transfer to a medium bowl. Peel and mince the garlic; add to bowl. Peel and mince or grate the ginger; add to bowl.
Wash the green onions, trim ends, and thinly slice on a angle; transfer to a small bowl.
In a small bowl, prepare the sauce by whisking together soy sauce, vinegar, and honey. Set aside.
Heat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Thinly slice the pork chops crosswise into bite-sized strips; transfer to a small bowl. Add soy sauce and toss to coat.
Add oil to the skillet and swirl to coat bottom. Add the pork and stir-fry until browned, 1-2 minutes. Transfer to a plate.
Add more oil to the skillet, then add the peppers, garlic, ginger, and green beans. Stir fry until the pepper is tender-crisp, 2-3 minutes.
Return pork to the skillet and pour in the sauce. Stir-fry until well combined, 1-2 minutes.
Place stir fry in a bowl and garnish with sliced green onions and chopped cashews. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
